items.title: Robots are redefining the war in Ukraine – and forcing Russia onto the back foot
items.titleCn: Robots are redefining the war in Ukraine – and forcing Russia onto the back foot
items.summary: Ukraine's robot forces achieved the first capture of a Russian position using only unmanned systems, with 22,000 missions conducted since January.
